correctness.rationale: The definition of Ind_2 is maximum induced degree at most one. Exact direct enumeration by neighbor counts and forbidden 2-edge vertex triples agrees, giving the Grötzsch 312 nonempty faces (11,55,110,95,36,5) and Chvátal 424 faces (12,66,148,142,52,4). Independent pivot matching and exhaustive Hasse topological sorts find Grötzsch 155 pairs with exactly one critical 0-cell and 2-cell (1030 incidences); Chvátal 211 pairs with one 0-cell and one 3-cell (1428 incidences). These full acyclic matchings imply S2 and S3 integrally, with no intermediate cells or attaching-map ambiguity. Triangle-free four-chromatic edge presentations checked in source; finite exact graph claims only.
